replace_model_with_quanto_layers: replace nn.Linear layers in a PyTorch model with quanto QLinear quantized layers
quantize_model_weights: quantize model weights to float8, int8, int4, or int2 using quanto weight types
exclude_modules_from_quantization: exclude specific named modules from quantization during layer replacement
freeze_pre_quantized_model: freeze a pre-quantized model to ensure state_dict compatibility during weight loading
detect_linear_modules: detect whether a model contains nn.Linear modules before applying quantization
